We use large language models (LLMs) to generate pseudo-hypotheses for unlabeled premises. That is, we first fine-tune a class-specific LLM ϕ c for each NLI class c using labeled samples corresponding to that class. Subsequently, we provide an unlabeled premise to each of these class-specific fine-tuned LLMs to generate three hypotheses (one per class with the corresponding LLM).
